payload.body: vc has the pen while hv is afk. Next is ST0001 WP02, and add fail-fast: false to test.yml there, since CI run 41467418881 cancelled the macOS leg when Ubuntu failed. CI baseline for AC-01.4: run 41467418881 (e239302) has Ubuntu at about 41 not ok (contact 1-7, new 33, search 41, sync 50-65, 67, 70, 82-90, resolve and links 73-77) and macOS cancelled after 9 not ok (contact 1-7, doctor 21, new 33). Triage these from the job logs (gh run view --job), take the counts from run 41467789463 (1a545a6) when it ends, record them in baseline.md, then satisfy AC-01.4 and close WP01. Commit locally; no pushes until hv is back.
